Grading policy ke mutabiq, talib-e-ilm ko grades A, A -, B+, B, B -, C+, C, C -, D+, D, F, I, aur W diya jata hai har course ke liye. Yeh grades inke performance ke mutabiq hain:

A - Excellent
B - Good
C - Adequate
D - Minimum acceptable
F - Failure, jis talib-e-ilm ko puri course ko dubara karna hota hai
W - Course se withdrawn
I - Incomplete, jis talib-e-ilm ko specific time ke andar complete karna hota hai

Grade GPC (Grade Points/Credit Hour)
A - 4.00
A- - 3.67
B+ - 3.33
B - 3.00
B- - 2.67
C+ - 2.33
C - 2.00
C- - 1.67

dividing the total number of grade points with the total number of credit hours for the 
entire number of courses undertaken. In the case of repeating courses, only the most 
recent grades are taken into consideration for the calculation of GPA but all courses
